notes.title: Balaspire Demo Update 1 Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Here are the updates for Update 1 Hotfix 1 Highlights: 

Intro cutscene, 

Quick start Button for people who want to skip our cutscenes,

Press and hold during cutscenes to skip our scenes.., 

Overkill finishers, Unique combat finisher for Kitsunagi, 

Reworked shop stocking system for special cards, 

Overkill detection bug fixes, 

Misc. bug fixes
